programme.title: Seoul Raiders
programme.desc: JJ/Shu Qi and PI Lam (Dong jing gong lüe (2000)) steal 2 stolen USD100 plates in HK. Lam loses them - no US reward. Lam and his 3 cute angels try to get them again in Seoul as does JJ. Lots of fighting.

programme.title: The Magnificent Scoundrels
programme.desc: Valentino is a mediocre con artist who crosses paths with Kwan, a fellow con artist. Together, they impersonate various people and create numerous schemes to make money. Meanwhile, gangsters are making a scheme of their own.

programme.title: Seeding Of A Ghost
programme.desc: A Hong Kong taxi driver's life horribly falls apart after accidentally hitting a sorcerer with his cab. He decides to seek the sorcerer's help to turn the curse on his enemies at the expense of his own life.

programme.title: Winner Takes All
programme.desc: Two private detectives want to gain fame by solving a series of robberies. However, they were fooled by the King of Thieves during the investigation. It was later discovered that all the robberies were related to a Japanese businessman, Miyamoto.

programme.title: Never Leave
programme.desc: Never Leave

programme.title: That Demon Within
programme.desc: A dutiful cop, guilt-ridden over saving the life of a gang leader, becomes obsessed with bringing down the crime syndicate of the man he saved.

programme.title: Ghost Wedding
programme.desc: A photographer is entangled with a 'woman in red', leading to the deaths of his relatives one by one. When the girl he likes also died mysteriously, Zhi Cheng vows to find out the truth.

programme.title: A Man Called Hero
programme.desc: Hero Wah goes to study under Master Pride. When he returns to his parents, he learns that they have been murdered by a band of evil Westerners. After impregnating his wife Jade, he ventures to New York in search of his parents' killers.

programme.title: Hail The Judge
programme.desc: A judge tries to save a female innocent who's wrongly being accused for murder.

programme.title: Unbeatable
programme.desc: Fai, once a world champion in boxing, escapes to Macau from the loan sharks and unexpectedly encounters Qi, a young chap who is determined to win a boxing match.

programme.title: Doubles Cause Troubles
programme.desc: Two squabbling cousins find themselves in more trouble than they can imagine after their tenant ends up dead. The gangsters and the police are both after them, and they have no idea what they have done wrong!

programme.title: Nezha
programme.desc: A former top team racing driver wants to prove himself in a race but accidentally hurts his teammate Lily. When an inexperienced virtual car racing champion joins the team, can they team up to regain team's glory?

programme.title: 36 Secrets Of Courtship
programme.desc: Three lotharios vie to become principal of the Macho Man Training School, an extremely non-monastic institution dedicated to extremely non Shaolin-types of physical exertion.

programme.title: The Grey Men 2
programme.desc: A regime shift in Leka stirs chaos. Police send undercover Zheng Zha into Song Bang’s gang, unaware others are waiting to strike back and settle old scores.

programme.title: Let's Have A Baby
programme.desc: A charming tale of child-creating complications, featuring a rare comedic performance by Alex Man Chi-leung.

programme.title: Chinese Odyssey 2: Cinderella
programme.desc: The convoluted continuation of the adventures of the time-traveling, now-human Monkey King, who attempts to fulfill his divine destiny.

programme.title: Unmatchable Match
programme.desc: Ruthless gangster Guts pulls off a heist of diamonds, then enlists the aid of longtime triad member, Fei, to arrange a buyer for them. But when Guts double crosses the buyer, Fei ends up with the diamonds, wanted by both the cops and Guts.

programme.title: Whisper Of Silent Body
programme.desc: Forensic pathologist Qin works with his assistant and the police captain to resolve the backlog of cases.

programme.title: VR Fighter
programme.desc: Long Wei has post-traumatic stress disorder after his wife's death. One day, he encounters Amy who works for a VR technology firm and is invited for a new product test. After the test, he becomes the firm's VR fighter.

programme.title: Cherie
programme.desc: A rich old man and a sexy young photographer compete for a stunning young gym instructor. The younger man is clearly winning until the rich man offers a deal.

programme.title: The Monkey Is Back
programme.desc: Stone Monkey, has given hope to a desperate little girl. But Stone Monkey is defeated in a battle with the three-eyed God of War, causing him to lose his power and falls into the mortal world.

programme.title: Mr. Vampire Saga 4
programme.desc: A Taoist Priest isn't happy when his Buddhist Priest colleague moves in next door. They are subject to feuds and duels, but soon must overcome their problems when a vampire breaks loose from his coffin and wreaks havoc to the countryside.

programme.title: Casino Tycoon
programme.desc: Inspired by the story of Macau’s Casino King Stanley Ho, the movie traces his blood-splattered fight to the top from 1930s to 1960s. In 1941, a young graduate, Benny Ho, flees Hong Kong during the Japanese invasion and heads for Macau. Benny starts as a labourer but rises to the top of the city’s casino business with his courage, wisdom and diligence.

programme.title: I Love Lolanto
programme.desc: Small-time conman and mechanic Lolanto finds himself in trouble when he cheats gangster Yu Yan Tat out of his high-end sports car on a three-day loan, where new sparkplugs would have sufficed.

programme.title: Young Ip Man: Crisis Time
programme.desc: The whole school is held hostage during the day of an English speech competition. As Ip Man decides to step up and rise to the crisis, it is revealed that his master and his childhood friend are behind all this.

programme.title: Senggol Bacok

programme.title: Hijrah Cinta
programme.desc: The story follows Ust. Jefri Al Bukhori or Uje, once a rising star who wasted his talent in reckless living. Estranged from friends and breaking his mother’s hopes, his life takes a turn when Pipik enters, inspiring him to change and escape drugs..

programme.title: Bing Slamet Dukun Palsu

programme.title: Pesan Dari Surga

programme.title: Kuntilanak (IMC)

programme.title: Petualangan 100 Jam

programme.title: Pulau Hantu 3

programme.title: Tabah Sampai Akhir

Melalui Sebuah Alat Bernama Superbook, Mereka Bertiga Mampu Menjelajah Lorong Waktu, Bertemu Dengan Tokoh-Tokoh Alkitab, Dan Menjadi Saksi Mata Sejarah. Melalui Petualangan Mereka Inilah, Superbook Membawa Pesan Alkitab Kepada Generasi Anak-Anak Di Era Digital.

programme.title: Bread Barbershop
programme.desc: Bread, Seorang Tukang Cukur Jenius, Memecahkan Masalah Penampilan Dengan Keterampilan Memotong Rambutnya Yang Briliant. Sekarang Dia Hadir Untuk Memecahkan Masalah Para Bintang Di Bakery Town. Bertentangan Dengan Penampilan Mereka Yang Glamor Dan Bersinar, Para Selebriti Ini Menjalani Hari Yang Sangat Suram. Bread Dan Keluarganya Siap Membantu Para Selebriti Untuk Menemukan Lagi Kebahagiaan Mereka.

programme.title: Metal Cardbot
programme.desc: Dahulu Kala, Terdapat Sebuah Planet Bernama Machina Dimana Metal Cardbots Tinggal. Suatu Ketika, Planet Ini Tiba-Tiba Meledak Dan Memaksa Semua Penghuninya Untuk Hidup Di Bumi. Agar Tidak Menarik Perhatian Makhluk Bumi, Cardbots Menyamar Sebagai Kendaraan Sehari-Hari. Hingga Suatu Hari, Seorang Anak Sekolah Dasar Yang Bernama Jun Secara Tidak Sengaja Menemukan Metal Breath, Dengan Metal Breath Tersebut Dia Bisa Menangkap Dan Menyalakan Cardbots Dengan Kemampuan Yang Berbeda.

programme.title: Gavan Infinity
programme.desc: Menceritakan Kisah Reiji Doki, Penyelidik Polisi Federal Galaksi, Yang Mengemban Gelar Space Sheriff Gavan. Ia Menyelidiki Emorgear Energi Kehidupan Yang Bereaksi Terhadap Emosi Negatif Guna Menghentikan Ancaman Kriminal Lintas Dimensi Yang Dapat Meruntuhkan

programme.title: Adu Kelas
programme.desc: Adu Kelas Merupakan Program Variety Show Yang Menayangkan Kompetisi Berupa Game Antar Angkatan Atau Antar Kelas Di Dalam Suatu Perlombaan, Menghadirkan Penampilan Bintang Tamu, Serta Menampilkan Pertunjukkan Minat Dan Bakat Siswa Siswi Sma Yang Menjadi Tuan Rumah. Program Ini Akan Dipandu Oleh Seorang Host Dan Duta Kelas Yang Pastinya Seru, Lucu Dan Kekinian.

programme.title: Cai Yoo (Cerita Anak Indonesia Yoo Yoo Yoo)
programme.desc: Program Hiburan Yang Edukatif Yang Disajikan Bagi Penonton Anak-Anak, Dipandu Oleh Seorang Host Yang Akan Mendatangi Sekolah-Sekolah Untuk Mengajak Siswa Bermain Sambil Belajar Bersama. Program Ini Akan Menampilkan Praktik Sains Dari Kakak Ilmuwan, Pertunjukan Dongeng, Hingga Pertunjukan Bakat Siswa Seperti Menyanyi, Menari, Berolahraga, Dll. Pada Setiap Bagian Program Terdapat Pembelajaran Bagi Siswa Yang Dikemas Lebih Menyenangkan.

programme.title: Abrakadabra
programme.desc: Abrakadabra Merupakan Sebuah Reality Show Yang Menghadirkan Hiburan Street Magician, Dimana Para "Pesulap" Akan Memberikan Keajaiban Dengan Trik-Trik Rahasia Yang Memukau Setiap Mata Di Sekitar Area Publik Untuk Mendapatkan Reaksi Kagum, Tak Percaya Dan Kaget Dari Penonton Maupun Semua Orang Yang Melihatnya Secara Langsung Di Lokasi.

programme.title: Grizzy And The Lemmings
programme.desc: Grizzy & The Lemmings Merupakan Animasi Yang Menceritakan Tentang Seekor Beruang Grizzly Yang Bernama Grizzy Dan Sekawanan Leming Yang Selalu Ingin Bermain Dengan Grizzy Setiap Harinya Sehingga Banyak Cerita Dan Petualangan Yang Menarik Dari Mereka.

programme.title: Smurfs
programme.desc: Di Tengah Hutan Belantara, Terdapat Desa Rahasia Dihuni Oleh Sekelompok Makhluk Kecil Berwarna Biru Yang Dipimpin Oleh Papa Smurf. Para Smurf Tinggal Di Rumah Berbentuk Jamur Dan Hidup Dengan Damai. Namun, Kedatangan Penyihir Jahat Gargamel Dan Kucingnya, Azrael, Merusak Kedamaian Desa Tersebut. Sehingga Para Smurf Harus Mencari Cara Agar Tidak Ditangkap Oleh Gargamel Dan Azrael.

programme.title: Boboiboy
programme.desc: Sebuah Program Animasi Yang Mengisahkan Boboiboy Dan Teman-Temannya Yakni Gopal, Ying, Dan Yaya Yang Masing-Masing Memiliki Kekuatan Super. Dengan Kekuatan Yang Dimiliki Mereka Mencegah Adu Du Mencuri Biji Kakao Tok Aba Yang Digunakan Sebagai Sumber Energi. Selain Itu, Boboiboy Dan Teman-Temannya Menjadi Pahlawan Super Dalam Menumpas Kejahatan Dan Menjaga Kedamaian Bumi.

programme.title: Ejen Ali
programme.desc: Serial Animasi Dengan Tokoh Utaman Bernama Ali Yang Tidak Sengaja Menjadi Agen Meta Advance Tactical Agency (Mata) Kemudian Dilatih Untuk Menjadi Agen Di Akademi Mata. Ali Membuktikan Diri Bahwa Ia Mampu Menjadi Agen Mata Dan Mengalahkan Musuh Bersama Alicia Dan Paman Bakar.

programme.title: Riko The Series
programme.desc: Animasi Lokal Yang Mengangkat Keseharian Seorang Anak Bernama Riko Bersama Sahabat Robotnya, Q110 Untuk Menemukan Dan Mempelajari Hal-Hal Baru Disekitarnya. Q110 Bertugas Menjelaskan Kepada Riko Hal-Hal Baru Yang Mereka Temukan. Berkat Q110, Riko Mempelajari Banyak Pengetahuan Soal Ilmuan-Ilmuan Muslim Dari Penjuru Dunia, Kekuasaan Allah Sang Maha Pencipta, Dan Tentunya Banyak Hal Lainya.

programme.title: Quantum Heroes Dinoster
programme.desc: Empat Sahabat Bernama Lucio, Delby, Jay Min, Dan Oz Melakukan Perjalanan Rahasia Ke Bumi Dinosaurus Untuk Menyelamatkan Para Dinosaurus Dari Bahaya, Mereka Disebut Tim Dinoster. Petualangan Mereka Dibantu Oleh Seorang Ilmuwan Kuantum Yaitu Professor Laura. Mereka Bersama-Sama Berusaha Untuk Melindungi Dinosaurus Dari Bahaya Alam Dan Bex Hunter, Seorang Ilmuwan Yang Ingin Membuat Dinosaurus Melawan Manusia.

programme.title: Papa Pipi
programme.desc: Papa Pipi Adalah Sebuah Acara Animasi Kekeluargaan Yang Mengisahkan Tentang Papa Zola Dan Anak Perempuannya, Pipi Zola. Bersama-Sama Mereka Menjalani Petualangan Cilik Yang Terkadang Menjadi Lebih Menantang Dalam Kehidupan Mereka.

programme.title: Boboiboy Galaxy The Movie
programme.desc: Boboiboy Galaxy Merupakan Sebuah Kisah Tentang Robot-Robot Power Sphera Yang Dibuat Untuk Memberikan Kekuasaan Besar Kepada Pemiliknya. Namun, Proyek Power Sphera Akhirnya Dianggap Sebagai Proyek Yang Berbahaya Dan Dibatalkan, Sedangkan Power Sphera Yang Lain Melarikan Diri Dan Bersembunyi Di Berbagai Pelosok Galaksi.

programme.title: Metal Cardbot
programme.desc: Dahulu Kala, Terdapat Sebuah Planet Bernama Machina Dimana Metal Cardbots Tinggal. Suatu Ketika, Planet Ini Tiba-Tiba Meledak Dan Memaksa Semua Penghuninya Untuk Hidup Di Bumi. programme.title: Boba (Bombastis Banget)
programme.desc: Boba (Bombastis Banget) Merupakan Program Yang Berisi Informasi Ringan Yang Menyajikan Video-Video Bombastis Yang Viral, Lucu, Dan Unik Dari Sosial Media. Bisa Berupa Video Kejadian Yang Tidak Biasa Ataupun Video Yang Sedang Viral. Video-Video Tersebut Akan Dikomentari Dengan Menggunakan Vo (Voice Over) Dan Dikemas Dengan Editing Yang Kekinian.

programme.title: Check In (Check Informasi)
programme.desc: Program Yang Menyajikan Fakta-Fakta Unik Tentang Fenomena Serta Isu Terkini Yang Terjadi Di Dunia Melalui Video-Video Yang Bersumber Dari Media Sosial Dan Dipaparkan Oleh Voice Over (Vo) Yang Unik. Check In Juga Akan Mengajak Interaksi Dengan Masyarakat Melalui Voxpop Tentang Tema Yang Dibahas.

programme.title: Obral (Obrolan Viral)
programme.desc: Obral (Obrolan Viral) Merupakan Program Informasi Yang Dipandu Oleh Dua Host Untuk Menyajikan Berita Terkini, Video Viral Dan Membahas Hal-Hal Unik Yang Dibicarakan Publik Secara Santai Dan Unik Dengan Format Semi Podcast Ala Radio Show.

programme.desc: The haenyeos are having trouble with collecting seafood under water because of the newly built factory nearby. To make a living, they started doing smuggling business.

programme.title: Hello Ghost (tvN Movies)
programme.desc: A man's failed suicide attempt enables him to see ghosts, who later keep following him everywhere. It is now up to him to fulfill their wishes to make them go away.

programme.title: Revolver
programme.desc: Jake Green is a hotshot gambler, long on audacity and short on common sense. Jake served seven years in jail for a crime he didn't commit after taking the rap for mean crime boss Dorothy Macha. Upon his release he takes on Macha in a private casino game, causes humiliation, and wins. While Macha puts out an order on Jake's life, Jake meets brothers Avi and Zach who protect him and plot to take Macha down.

programme.title: Honeysweet (tvN Movies)
programme.desc: Chi-ho is a successful product designer. Il-young works in a loan company. They meet at her company when he try to pay his brother's debt. Coincidence brings them to become closer.

programme.title: Dragon Inn: The City Of Sadness (tvN Movies)
programme.desc: A secret club centered in an ordinary Chinese restaurant Dragon Inn investigates and solves the cases. However, one case turns a serious one when the son of CEO is found dead, and a possible murderer is the member of Dragon Inn.

programme.title: Love 911
programme.desc: When a doctor gets sued for misdiagnosing a patient, she reaches out to a dedicated firefighter to be a character witness for her. An unlikely romance sparks between the two of them.

programme.title: Ordinary Person
programme.desc: An up-righteous police officer with a wife and son gets involved with a conspiracy after he arrested a murderer by chance. His weakness was his son needed an operation to treat his legs. Which path to choose? Righteousness or conspiracy?

programme.title: A Melody To Remember
programme.desc: During the Korean War, Second Lieutenant Sang-Yeol encounters a group of orphans while leading his platoon. Empathizing with their pain, he makes a choir with the children to protect them.

programme.title: Pretty Crazy
programme.desc: A pastry chef apprentice lives unaware she becomes a wild she-devil nightly. Her family hires their neighbor to watch her night version, as he falls for her day self while seeking to break her curse.

programme.title: ActionHero
programme.desc: A college student dreaming to be an action star discovered an admission fraud. He decided to make an action film of him against the corrupted professor.

programme.title: Cart
programme.desc: The employees of a big-box discount retailer band together when the contract workers are summarily laid off.

programme.title: The Roundup: No Way Out
programme.desc: There is a drug case links to an organized crime organization in Japan. Despite the expanding scale of the case, the beast cop and his team strive their best to arrest the criminal.

programme.title: The Girl on a Bulldozer
programme.desc: At 19 years old, Goo Hye-young is notorious for her rebellious nature, often finding herself embroiled in conflicts. Now, she faces the challenge of tempering her anger and enrolling in a vocational training program. Despite being discouraged due to its perceived unsuitability for women, she resolves to master the operation of a bulldozer.

programme.title: Killing Romance
programme.desc: A retired actress who marries an island chaebol and meets a 3-time-test-taker who lives next door.

programme.title: Okay! Madam
programme.desc: A married couple unwittingly become involved in a rescue operation of a hijacked aircraft during their first-ever family trip abroad to Hawaii.

programme.title: Dragon Inn: The City Of Sadness
programme.desc: Dragon Inn: The City of Sadness follows a secret organization operating behind the façade of a Chinese restaurant known as Dragon Inn. Its members dedicate themselves to punishing criminals whom the legal system has failed to bring to justice. Each member carries a troubled past and a personal reason for joining the group. Their mission becomes increasingly complicated when the son of a powerful businessman is murdered and one of Dragon Inn’s own members becomes a suspect. As hidden motives, betrayals, and violent confrontations emerge, the organization finds itself fighting not only external enemies but also internal conflicts that threaten its survival.

programme.title: The Childe (tvN Movies)
programme.desc: Desperate to get funds for his mother's surgery, an amateur boxer travels from the Philippines to Korea in hopes of tracking down his father. However, in the process, he gets involved with some bad guys.

programme.title: Dragon Inn: Night Of Salvation (tvN Movies)
programme.desc: Dragon Inn investigates the mysterious disappearance of a girl with no reason to run away. Their search leads to a pseudo-religious cult, but their identities are exposed. Can they defeat the cult and rescue the girl?

programme.title: The Tiger
programme.desc: While the Kingdom of Korea is under occupation by the Japanese, an old and experienced hunter is challenged by the hunt of the last tiger.

programme.title: You Will Die In 6 Hours
programme.desc: Jun Woo alerts Jeong Yun about her upcoming murder. Skeptical, she investigates, uncovering Jun Woo's link to serial killings. She races to learn if he's protecting or deceiving her before her prophesized death.

programme.title: 6/45: Lucky Lotto
programme.desc: The excitement of winning a lottery ticket doesn't last long for sergeant Chun-woo as it accidentally ends up crossing the Military Demarcation Line. He must get his act together and find it again!
